summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for the issuance of $4,570,000 aggregate principal amount of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due December 29, 2032, linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100 Index, Russell 2000 Index, and VanEck Semiconductor ETF. The notes are senior unsecured obligations under its medium-term note program, with an issue price of $1,000 per note, priced on June 26, 2026, and issued on June 30, 2026. Terms include monthly contingent coupon payments of $21.08, autocallability starting December 2026, and principal at risk if the worst-performing underlying falls below the threshold. This is a routine structured product offering, not a special situation.
